title: Tangy
summary: Vinegar, buttermilk, yogurt marinades — tang tenderizes and brightens rich food.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — tangy is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: acid, ferment, salt. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Fat rounds sharp tang; sugar only if balance still reads sour.
